Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results and conflated Dell’s “USB PowerShare” with “USB Wake Support” (wake-on-USB), then prematurely declared the task complete. Despite WebSurfer surfacing a Dell support article explicitly titled “USB PowerShare,” the Planner synthesized “USB Wake Support (also called PowerShare)” and provided the wrong term. The correct Dell feature name for keeping USB powered when the computer is off is PowerShare.
